verdict.summary: SPEC-0336: harden nw worker gate-job (stricter header and gate validation, \Z regexes, remote: slot ids, a jobs lock that fixes the gc race, SIGTERM/SIGINT/SIGHUP cancel) and add the missing tests. In this loop the targeted worker, slot, gate and rich-output-guard tests passed 157/157 three runs in a row, and spec-lint passed. The full suite is left to gating.
tests_run: uv run pytest -q -n 4 tests/test_worker.py tests/test_worker_ssh_command.py tests/test_gate_slots.py tests/test_cli_gate_slots.py tests/test_agentic_gates.py tests/test_rich_output_guard.py (157 passed, x3)

ac_status.ac: Valid header+bundle runs gates, emits accepted/started/gate/done with .log/.json/.r<n> files
merge-base $NW_BASE HEAD on the worker matches the coordinator
Env key outside allowlist -> validate error, nothing runs; reused job_id -> claim
Two concurrent jobs, same repo_key/base.name, different base.sha each see their own base
EOF mid-gate ends the gate process, done interrupted; EOF during slot wait -> done interrupted, no started
Held slot -> slot_wait then started once it frees
Log over 16 MiB cut to 16 MiB with truncated_bytes
have reports commit/base after job; gc --keep-days 0 removes refs, objects, job dirs; live job dir survives
nw worker info --json prints documented keys
ssh-command execs the four allowed subcommands, refuses everything else with exit 2
docs/WORKFLOW.md documents mandatory dedicated user and absolute-path key line
